item.title: Charleston County School of the Arts Wind Ensemble To Take The National Stage
item.description: The Charleston County School of the Arts (SOA) Wind Ensemble has been selected by Music for All as a featured ensemble at the 2026 National Festival in Indianapolis, Indiana this coming March.

item.title: City of North Charleston Seeking Visual Artists for 2026 Residencies
item.description: The City of North Charleston Cultural Arts Department is now seeking visual artists for its Artist-in-Residence (AIR) Program for 2026.

item.title: Nick Uricchio Announces Candidacy for SC House District 115
item.description: Nick Uricchio this week announced his candidacy for South Carolina House District 115, running as a Democrat to succeed State Representative Spencer Wetmore, who is retiring at the end of the year.

item.title: Charleston Scottish Games and Highland Gathering Canceled for 2026
item.description: The Charleston Scottish Games and Highland Gathering, a long-running annual cultural event, has announced that its 2026 event has been canceled.

item.title: Juvenile to Perform at the Charleston Music Hall in April
item.description: Juvenile, the rapper behind hit singles like "Ha" and "Slow Motion," will be performing at the Charleston Music Hall on Friday, April 10, 2026. He’ll be joined by The 400 Degreez Band.

item.title: How PayPal Became the Global Link Between Entertainment and Financial Security
item.description: In today’s digital-first world, entertainment and finance are more closely connected than ever. Streaming platforms, online gaming, digital marketplaces, and mobile apps all rely on fast, secure, and trusted payment systems to keep users engaged. Few companies embody this intersection better than PayPal. What began as a simple online payment solution has evolved into a global financial bridge, enabling people to enjoy digital entertainment while maintaining a strong sense of financial security.

item.title: Transportation Tips for Getting Around Charleston as a Visitor
item.description: A trip to Charleston is one of the experiences of going into a living post-card. Stone paved roads, pink hues of houses, ocean vistas, and centuries old history is what makes it a destination that must be seen in a slow manner. The navigational experience of the city will make one not to get in a rush but explore the beauty of Charleston fully. The modes of transport be it on foot or on a ride characterize how the visitors ground themselves in the city.

item.title: South Carolina Drops Saturday Night Decision to Savannah, 5-1
item.description: The South Carolina Stingrays fell to the Savannah Ghost Pirates, 5-1, on Saturday evening at the North Charleston Coliseum in front of a sellout crowd of 7,342 fans on Military Appreciation Night, presented by Budweiser and Folds of Honor.

item.title: South Carolina Bounces Back With 4-0 Shutout of Savannah
item.description: Behind three first-period goals and a 41-save shutout from Seth Eisele, the South Carolina Stingrays won their sixth consecutive road game, 4-0, on Sunday afternoon at Enmarket Arena.
